title: Compact strip
description: One 36 px line: caught counts per class, misses, accuracy and combo status. Drops the proportion bars, column headings and the max-achievable readout.

title: Show accuracy
description: Shows accuracy and, during play, the maximum accuracy still reachable if every remaining object is caught (needs vosu's or tosu's /api/calculate/pp for the map's object counts).

title: Show 18—LAB tag
description: The small brand tag at the left of the header.
